items.definition:
a loud, resonant metallic sound
We heard the clang of the bell from the distant tower.

a photograph or film shot taken at close range
The photographer took a closeup of the flower's petals.

a native or inhabitant of Croatia, or a person of Croatian descent
Many Croats live in other European countries.

decaffeinated coffee
I'll have a decaf latte, please.

A string used to pull and tighten fabric.
The hood of the jacket had a drawstring.

A short bar with weights at each end, used for exercise.
He lifted the dumbbell to strengthen his arms.

A small piece of material inserted into the ear to keep out noise or water.
She wore earplugs to block out the noise from the construction.

A bridge designed for pedestrians.
We crossed the river on a narrow footbridge.

A person who predicts future events or trends, especially weather.
The weather forecaster predicted heavy rain for tomorrow.

grandfather (informal)
My gramp always tells the best stories.

Mahjong (a game)
They spent the afternoon playing mahjong.

A green, pod-shaped vegetable.
She added okra to the stew.

A Spanish rice dish with seafood, meat, and vegetables.
We had delicious paella for dinner.

A small electronic device that receives signals or messages.
Doctors used pagers to receive urgent calls.

a type of palm with long, tough stems, used for making furniture
The patio furniture was made of durable rattan.

the basic monetary unit of Russia and some other former Soviet republics
The exchange rate for the rouble fluctuated significantly.

a rhythmic dance of Cuban origin
They learned to dance the rumba at the studio.

a garment worn by Hindu women, consisting of a long piece of cotton or silk wrapped around the body
She looked elegant in her traditional silk saree.

a person who types
The typist quickly transcribed the entire interview.

a punch delivered with an upward motion
The boxer landed a powerful uppercut to his opponent's jaw.

a roofed open-air gallery or portico attached to the exterior of a building
We enjoyed our morning coffee on the spacious verandah.

the level reached by the surface of water on the side of a ship or boat
The ship's waterline was marked with a distinct red paint.

a blog; a regularly updated website or web page
She started a weblog to document her culinary adventures.

a person or ship engaged in whaling
The old whaler recounted tales of his voyages to the Arctic.

a small recessed section of a room
There was a cozy reading alcove by the window.

a short-legged dog of a breed of hound
My neighbor has a friendly basset hound.

a flammable hydrocarbon gas
Lighters are often filled with butane gas.

a taxi driver
The cabbie knew all the shortcuts in the city.

an aromatic European plant used for herbal tea
I like to drink chamomile tea before bed to relax.

a sharp, ringing sound
We heard the clink of glasses as they toasted.

plates, dishes, cups, and other similar items, especially ones made of earthenware or porcelain
She carefully washed the delicate crockery.

a person or thing that pulls
He used a gear puller to remove the stubborn part.

a savory tart with a pastry crust and a filling of eggs, cheese, and other ingredients
For lunch, we had a delicious slice of quiche.

the state or quality of being slow
The slowness of the internet connection was frustrating.

a female flight attendant
The stewardess served drinks to the passengers.

a starchy substance in the form of hard white grains, obtained from the cassava plant and used for puddings and other dishes
She made a delicious tapioca pudding for dessert.

a high, close-fitting, turned-over collar, or a garment with such a collar
He wore a black turtleneck sweater.

a dressing made from oil, vinegar, and seasonings
I prefer a simple vinaigrette on my salad.

a frankfurter or hot dog; also, a timid or ineffectual person
He felt like a total weenie for being scared.

a person who arranges things, especially music
The band's arranger created a new version of the song.

the musical calls and sounds made by birds
We woke up to the sweet sound of birdsong.

A person involved in business
She is a successful businessperson with several ventures.

A device that makes a clicking sound, often used for training animals or as a remote control
He used a clicker to train his dog to sit.

An arrival or approach
The coming of the new year brings hope.

a bridge that can be raised or lowered
The castle's drawbridge was lowered for visitors.

a tropical fruit
She made a delicious jam from fresh guava.

a person who has charge of a jail or of the prisoners in it
The jailer locked the cell door securely.

curb (edge of a pavement)
The car scraped against the kerb as it parked.

a type of noodle
I love eating mie with my stir-fry.

a large, edible mushroom
I grilled a portobello mushroom for dinner last night.

a sweater that is pulled over the head
He wore a warm wool pullover to protect himself from the cold.

thinly sliced raw fish
We ordered a plate of fresh sashimi.

a room for storing things
We keep all our old furniture in the storeroom.

a ten-pound or ten-dollar note
Can you lend me a tenner until payday?

a word that modifies a verb, adjective, or other adverb
The word 'quickly' is an adverb.

a small bird (often used endearingly or by children)
Look at the little birdy singing in the tree.

a person or animal that bites
Be careful, that dog is a known biter.

a transparent paper-like material
She wrapped the gift in clear cellophane.

a tight-fitting necklace
She wore a velvet choker around her neck.

a North African dish of steamed semolina
We had chicken and couscous for dinner.

kilometers per hour
The car was traveling at 100 kph.

a person who reads the news on television or radio
The newsreader announced the latest headlines.

an edible seaweed, especially a species of red algae, typically used in Japanese cuisine
Sushi rolls are often wrapped in sheets of nori.

Mrs.; madam
The polite young man addressed the woman as Señora Rodriguez.
